description: This file defines the EcrClient class, a PHP client for interacting with the Amazon EC2 Container Registry (ECR) service, including methods for various ECR operations.

classes.name: EcrClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, tailored for Amazon ECR interactions with methods for performing various registry operations.

methods.name: batchCheckLayerAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of image layers in ECR.

methods.name: batchGetRepositoryScanningConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the scanning configuration for repositories.

methods.name: createPullThroughCacheRule
methods.description: Creates a cache rule for pulling images.

methods.name: createRepositoryCreationTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template for repository creation.

methods.name: describeImageReplicationStatus
methods.description: Describes the status of image replication.

methods.name: describePullThroughCacheRules
methods.description: Provides information about pull-through cache rules.

methods.name: describeRepositoryCreationTemplates
methods.description: Provides information about repository creation templates.

methods.name: getAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Gets an authorization token for ECR.

methods.name: getDownloadUrlForLayer
methods.description: Retrieves download URL for a layer.

methods.name: putImage
methods.description: Pushes an image to the repository.

methods.name: startLifecyclePolicyPreview
methods.description: Starts a preview of the lifecycle policy.

methods.name: uploadLayerPart
methods.description: Uploads a part of a layer.
